read.title: Planning Your Next Order
read.text:
Dear Ms. Silva,

I hope sales of our sheet masks are going well in Brazil. According to your last report, your stock level was about 2,000 units, which may last only four more weeks.

Since our factory is very busy before the Lunar New Year, I recommend placing your next reorder by December 10 to avoid any delays. If you share your sales forecast for the first quarter, we can reserve production capacity for you.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee

write.en: Ask a Japanese distributor about their stock level of your cleansing balm and suggest reordering early to avoid delays.
write.model:
Dear Mr. Ito,

I hope sales are going well in Japan. Could you let me know your current stock level of our cleansing balm? Our factory will be busy in January, so I suggest placing your reorder by mid-December to avoid any delays.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee
